items.title: ABQ RIDE Sun Van Compliance Review Briefing
items.description: Summarizes a 2010 consultant review of Sun Van’s ADA paratransit service, documenting eligibility, service area, reservations, fares, trip times, capacity constraints, driver practices, and recommended eligibility-process improvements while finding no ADA compliance violations.

items.title: Draft Sun Van Performance Metrics
items.description: Defines draft Sun Van performance measures covering ridership, cost, productivity, cancellations, no-shows, subsidy, on-time pickups, missed trips, scheduling flexibility, and complaint categories, preserving how the City proposed to monitor paratransit service in 2010.
